src = open('offline_discovery/rule_generate.py').read()

start = src.index("def _neighbor_mask(points, eps_num, eps_den):")
end = src.index("def _neighbor_mask_padded(points, eps_num, eps_den):")
new = '''def _neighbor_mask(points, eps_num, eps_den):
    """Exact `distance <= eps` adjacency for equal-length real sequences.

    Fragment coordinates never hold the padding token, so shifting every value
    above the padding gap by 1000 turns the contract coordinate distance
    (|a-b|, plus 1000 when the pair straddles 1514) into a plain |T(a)-T(b)|.
    Squared distances then follow from one exact float64 Gram product and the
    anchor exponents from per-coordinate equality counts. Only pairs whose
    floating image lands inside a narrow band around eps^2 are re-decided with
    the exact integer form  sum*q^2*9^A <= L*p^2*25^A.
    """
    size, length = points.shape
    mask = np.zeros((size, size), dtype=np.uint8)
    if size == 0:
        return mask
    if bool((points == PAD).any()):
        # Only reachable if a caller feeds padded coordinates; contract
        # fragments are taken from real prefixes and never contain padding.
        return _neighbor_mask_padded(points, eps_num, eps_den)
    shifted = points.astype(np.int32)
    shifted += np.where(shifted > PAD, 1000, 0)
    anchors = np.zeros((size, size), dtype=np.int8)
    for axis in range(length):
        column = shifted[:, axis]
        anchors += (column[:, None] == column[None, :])
    weights = shifted.astype(np.float64)
    square = np.einsum('ij,ij->i', weights, weights)
    target = float(eps_num)/float(eps_den)
    target_sq = target*target
    tolerance = 1e-12*max(target_sq, 1.0)
    exact_num = eps_num*eps_num
    exact_den = eps_den*eps_den
    rows = max(1, min(size, (1 << 21)//max(1, size*8)))
    for start in range(0, size, rows):
        stop = min(size, start+rows)
        totals = square[start:stop, None]+square[None, :] - 2.0*(weights[start:stop] @ weights.T)
        block_anchors = anchors[start:stop]
        scaled = (totals/length)*POW36_SQ[block_anchors]
        close = np.abs(scaled-target_sq) <= tolerance
        block = np.where(close, 0, scaled <= target_sq).astype(np.uint8)
        if close.any():
            ii, jj = np.nonzero(close)
            sums = totals[ii, jj].tolist()
            equals = block_anchors[ii, jj].astype(np.int64).tolist()
            for position in range(len(sums)):
                power = equals[position]
                block[ii[position], jj[position]] = (
                    int(round(sums[position]))*exact_den*POW9[power] <=
                    length*exact_num*POW25[power])
        mask[start:stop] = block
    return mask


'''
